review_scope: Independent rendered-image visual review and direct export inspection only.

review_method.earlier_candidate_images_scope: Only the preserved 96 dpi proxies from the initial independent image review, for the three requested final legend revisions.

external_checks.name: source numerical coverage and calculated statistics
external_checks.evidence: Intentionally excluded from this independent visual review. No source data, plotting code, renderer QA, or statistical check records were used.

external_checks.name: printed copy or journal acceptance
external_checks.evidence: 96 dpi PDF renders are final-size screen proxies; they are not print proof or journal assessment.

external_checks.name: baseline refinement preference
external_checks.evidence: Preserved baseline and new candidate 96 dpi PDF proxies were opened at equal final size for ECDF and both paired views. Preference is candidate for limited legend reading/style consistency; no overall aesthetic improvement is claimed.

ready_scope_note: This status concerns the inspected supplied panels and export properties only. It does not establish print proof, journal acceptance, broad aesthetic improvement beyond the limited legend comparison, or performance on other datasets.
packaging_note: Case-specific records extracted by the main agent from the independent final review. Reviewer findings and candidate hashes are unchanged. Development-only paths identify evidence retained outside this portable case.

cases.mapping: Seven conditions, HDR rose at the base, peach both-signal in the middle, green mutEJ on top. Dark raw total dots and one total-SD stroke sit around each stack top.
cases.visual_evidence: Rose/peach/green segments are distinguishable together; the thin SD strokes and dark dots stay visible above the fills. The one-row top component guide occupies about one third of the data-region width and a small shallow band. All seven rotated labels remain readable in the 567×378 proxy. The two near-zero controls are visible as three dark dots close to zero, but their tiny component contributions cannot be visually compared on the common scale.

findings.evidence: The common 0–60% reading scale makes the two control stacks extremely short. Their raw total dots remain visible, and the caption explicitly identifies near-zero controls.
findings.requirement: Keep all conditions and preserve the scientific scale without inventing a reference appearance.
findings.action: Retain the common scale and the supplied control explanation in the caption.

findings.evidence: The paper crop combines colored stacks and gray ratio bars on dual axes. This candidate splits the axes and adds total points and total SD, rather than copying the uncertain component-boundary intervals or unverified stars.
findings.requirement: Respect the disclosed create adaptation and distinguish total uncertainty from component uncertainty.
findings.action: Keep the explicit total-SD caption with this panel.

cases.visual_evidence: The current axis reads HDR/mutEJ ratio. Hatching identifies the controls clearly at the 567×378 proxy, with raw points visible above/on their bars. findings.requirement: Retain source values and communicate the state without adding prose inside the panel.
findings.action: Keep the supplied caption and the hatched state guide.

cases.mapping: Seven conditions with three side-by-side component colors and their raw component dots/SD strokes; this is an alternative create view rather than a published extra panel.
cases.visual_evidence: At 662×378 the three colors are distinct and the 4 pt² dots are small but distinguishable, including the near-zero control rows. Component-specific intervals remain adjacent to their component means. The wider 175 mm canvas keeps all rotated labels readable. The full three-entry guide is about 28% of the data-region width and remains subordinate to the data.

findings.location: point-size brief, resolved during this review
findings.evidence: The initially supplied adopted wording declared 7 pt² for all raw points, while grouped-spec.json declared 4 pt² and the grouped marks were visibly smaller. The current adopted wording explicitly states 7 pt² for stack/ratio and 4 pt² for the denser grouped alternative. Output PNG/PDF hashes were checked again and remain unchanged.
findings.requirement: The adopted specification and candidate must agree about physical mark sizes.
findings.action: Resolved by the explicit grouped exception in the current adopted brief; retain that exception with the portable example.
